inferential_status: RELEASE-2026 exploratory/development ecological estimate only; future NEON observations remain the confirmatory response

primary_universe.target_taxonomy: taxonProtocolCategory == target, published taxon concepts retained
primary_universe.bout: complete exact-3-night site x plotID x eventID
primary_universe.temporal_replication: taxon x plot series with >=3 scored sessions and >=2 distinct genus-MNKA values

variables.W: session equal-individual mean within-individual variance, m^2

primary_estimand.name: delta_beta
primary_estimand.definition: coefficient of genus MNKA in D = B - W
primary_estimand.interpretation: change in between-minus-within spatial variance, in m^2, per one additional known-alive congener

rationale: series fixed effects isolate temporal within-population covariation
site x month effects absorb site-specific seasonality
year effects absorb network-wide annual shifts
adjustment.transformations: identity scale only; do not log W or B after seeing effects because B_debiased may be signed

weighting.primary: inverse number of included sessions within genus, rescaled so each frozen replicated genus has equal total weight
weighting.rationale: prevent Peromyscus from dominating the generality claim by sample size alone

estimation.method: weighted fixed-effects least squares using Frisch-Waugh-Lovell residualization
estimation.robust_uncertainty: two-way cluster sandwich sensitivity by genus and site; coefficient sign and leave-one-genus-out stability are mandatory even if small-cluster CI is imprecise
estimation.genus_specific_check: within each frozen genus, fit the same response on MNKA with taxon x plot fixed effects; calendar adjustment is retained where estimable

required_for_development_support: delta_beta remains > 0 in every leave-one-genus-out primary fit
at least 6 of 8 frozen genus-specific delta_beta estimates are > 0
generality_guard.if_guard_fails: report the pattern as taxon/genus heterogeneous; do not rescue with habitat, body size, trophic group, or post-hoc subsets

sensitivities: drop site x month adjustment but retain series and year effects
forbidden_before_development_result: alternative abundance predictor selected by result
alternative spatial metric selected by result

future_confirmation.response: first NEON small-mammal observations not contained in RELEASE-2026
future_confirmation.rule: copy the final model and all inclusion/guard rules unchanged after development validation
